articles.title: TakeMe2Space to launch India’s first orbital computing satellite on SpaceX rocket
articles.summary: A Hyderabad-based startup's MOI-1A satellite is slated for launch later this year aboard a Falcon 9 rocket. This pioneering satellite will carry advanced Nvidia processors, capable of an impressive 117 trillion operations per second, into orbit. This initiative represents a significant stride in deploying high-performance computing capabilities in space, spearheaded by an Indian firm.
